      • getReadRepair

        public String getReadRepair()
        Returns the read_repair option for this table. NOTE: this is a Cassandra® 4.0 and newer option (described here: http://cassandra.apache.org/doc/latest/operating/read_repair.html). Possible values are BLOCKING or NONE, with the default being BLOCKING.
        Returns:
        the read repair option (either BLOCKING or NONE).

      • getDefaultTimeToLive

        public int getDefaultTimeToLive()
        Returns the default TTL for this table.

        Note: this option is not available in Cassandra 1.2 and will return 0 (no default TTL) when connected to 1.2 nodes.

        Returns:
        the default TTL for this table or 0 if no default TTL is configured.

      • getSpeculativeRetry

        public String getSpeculativeRetry()
        Returns the speculative retry option for this table.

        Note: this option is not available in Cassandra 1.2 and will return "NONE" (no speculative retry) when connected to 1.2 nodes.

        Returns:
        the speculative retry option this table.

      • getIndexInterval

        public Integer getIndexInterval()
        Returns the index interval option for this table.

        Note: this option is not available in Cassandra 1.2 (more precisely, it is not configurable per-table) and will return 128 (the default index interval) when connected to 1.2 nodes. It is deprecated in Cassandra 2.1 and above, and will therefore return null for 2.1 nodes.

        Returns:
        the index interval option for this table.

      • getMinIndexInterval

        public Integer getMinIndexInterval()
        Returns the minimum index interval option for this table.

        Note: this option is available in Cassandra 2.1 and above, and will return null for earlier versions.

        Returns:
        the minimum index interval option for this table.

      • getMaxIndexInterval

        public Integer getMaxIndexInterval()
        Returns the maximum index interval option for this table.

        Note: this option is available in Cassandra 2.1 and above, and will return null for earlier versions.

        Returns:
        the maximum index interval option for this table.

      • getCrcCheckChance

        public Double getCrcCheckChance()
        When compression is enabled, this option defines the probability with which checksums for compressed blocks are checked during reads. The default value for this options is 1.0 (always check).

        Note that this option is available in Cassandra 3.0.0 and above, when it became a "top-level" table option, whereas previously it was a suboption of the compression option.

        For Cassandra versions prior to 3.0.0, this method always returns null.

        Returns:
        the probability with which checksums for compressed blocks are checked during reads

      • getAdditionalWritePolicy

        public String getAdditionalWritePolicy()
        The threshold at which a cheap quorum write will be upgraded to include transient replicas.

        This option is only available in Cassandra® 4.0 and above. Default value is 99p.

        Returns:
        The additional write policy for this table (ex. '99p').
